subject: pe
title: Linear Motion
welcome_lead: Displacement, velocity, acceleration — the language of straight-line motion.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on kinematic equations applied to sport.
final_note: SUVAT equations link space and time — the physics behind every sprint and jump.

concepts.def: Change in position; vector with magnitude and direction (m).
Rate of change of displacement (m s⁻¹); vector.
Rate of change of velocity (m s⁻²).
Kinematic equations linking s, u, v, a, t under constant acceleration.
Third SUVAT equation; useful when t unknown.

walkthroughs.body_html: Distance is scalar; displacement is vector. Speed is scalar; velocity is vector.
v = u + at; s = ut + ½at²; v² = u² + 2as; s = ½(u+v)t; s = vt − ½at². Each links four of the five variables.
A sprinter accelerating from rest at 6 m s⁻² reaches 12 m s⁻¹ in 2 s.
